Package dev.ucomprotocol.discovery

Class UcpDiscoveryController

java.lang.Object
dev.ucomprotocol.discovery.UcpDiscoveryController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/.well-known/ucp") public class UcpDiscoveryController extends Object
Controller that exposes the Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) discovery endpoint.

This endpoint is available at /.well-known/ucp and returns the business profile of this commerce service. It adheres to the UCP specification version "2026-08-25", using the canonical namespace dev.ucp for all capabilities and services.

Capabilities are dynamically discovered based on the registered CommerceAdapter and enabled protocol extensions:

  • dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search and dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup: Present if CommerceAdapter.getCatalogAdapter() is not null.
  • dev.ucp.shopping.cart: Present if CommerceAdapter.getCartAdapter() is not null.
  • dev.ucp.shopping.checkout: Present if CommerceAdapter.getCheckoutAdapter() is not null.
  • dev.ucp.common.payment.ap2_mandate: Present if AP2 Mandates (ucp.ap2.enabled=true) and dev.ucp.shopping.checkout are active, publishing the merchant public EC key in top-level keys[].
  • dev.ucp.shopping.order: Present if CommerceAdapter.getOrderAdapter() is not null.
  • dev.ucp.common.identity_linking: Present if CommerceAdapter.getCustomerAdapter() is not null.

Services (dev.ucp.shopping) are advertised for each transport endpoint configured under ucp.services.* in UcpProperties.
